EP45:E45 62600-66800 ALEXANDER [Booming, Condemning]: "You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife."

EP45:E53 74800-80400 ALEXANDER [Proclaiming, Powerful]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!"

EP45:E55 81500-83000 RUPERT [Gasping, Shellshocked]: "Juliana?!"

EP45:E64 93200-101100 HIGH PRIEST [Commanding, Severe]: "This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union."
EP45:E65 101200-105800 CAMERA: Close-up on the High Priest unfolding the document, reading aloud to the congregation.
EP45:E66 101500-105500 HIGH PRIEST [Stern, Official]: "These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register."

EP45:E68 106200-108800 HIGH PRIEST [O.S.) (Harsh, Resolute]: "Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton."

EP45:E70 109000-113000 HIGH PRIEST [Unyielding, Condemning]: "You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife."
